- name: Resolve the base of the changed-file gates
        # A pull-request run checks out GitHub's merge commit, whose first parent is the base it was merged onto.
        # The event's base SHA can be older than that parent, and then `base...HEAD` also lists files that changed
        # on the base branch. Any other checkout keeps the event's SHA.
        env:
          EVENT_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || (github.event.before != '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' && github.event.before || '') }}
        run: |
          base="$EVENT_BASE"
          if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = pull_request ] && git rev-parse --verify --quiet 'HEAD^2^{commit}' >/dev/null; then
            base="$(git rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^1^{commit}')"
          fi
          echo "changed-file base: ${base:-<none>}"
          echo "NEXUS_CHANGED_BASE=$base" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Static gates (typecheck, clippy, changed-file rustfmt)
        run: NEXUS_FMT_BASE="$NEXUS_CHANGED_BASE" make lint
      - run: cargo test --locked --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml
      - name: Terminal scope gate (the second half of `npm --prefix cli test`)
        run: npm --prefix cli run test:scope

  test-shard:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 50
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false # a failing leg must not hide the failures of the others
      matrix:
        node: [22, 24]
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # tests read repository history
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install --yes acl make bubblewrap build-essential meson ninja-build pkg-config libcap-dev
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.22.12'
      - name: Install pinned evaluator toolchains
        run: bash scripts/install-evaluator-toolchains.sh
      - run: bash scripts/ensure-ci-bubblewrap.sh
      - run: bash scripts/ensure-ci-user-cgroups.sh
      - name: Mount a dedicated capped tmpfs for evaluator resource fixtures
        run: |
          root=/mnt/nexus-eval-ci
          sudo install -d -o "$USER" -g "$USER" -m 0711 "$root"
          sudo mount -t tmpfs -o size=128m,mode=0711,uid="$(id -u)",gid="$(id -g)" nexus-eval-ci "$root"
          echo "NEXUS_EVAL_TEST_WORKSPACE_ROOT=$root" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          runtime_root=/opt/nexus-eval-ci-runtime
          sudo install -d -o "$USER" -g "$USER" -m 0711 "$runtime_root"
          echo "NEXUS_EVAL_TEST_RUNTIME_ROOT=$runtime_root" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: cli/package-lock.json
      - name: Install selected Node runtime for isolated evaluation commands
        run: |
          node_runtime="$(readlink -f "$(command -v node)")"
          npm_cli="$(readlink -f "$(command -v npm)")"
          npm_root="$(dirname "$(dirname "$npm_cli")")"
          case "$npm_root" in */lib/node_modules/npm) ;; *) echo "Unexpected setup-node npm package path" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
          test -f "$npm_root/package.json"
          sudo install -o root -g root -m 0755 "$node_runtime" /usr/bin/node
          sudo install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /usr/lib/nexus-ci/npm
          sudo cp -a "$npm_root/." /usr/lib/nexus-ci/npm/
          sudo chown -hR root:root /usr/lib/nexus-ci/npm
          sudo chmod 0755 /usr/lib/nexus-ci/npm/bin/npm-cli.js
          sudo ln -sfn /usr/lib/nexus-ci/npm/bin/npm-cli.js /usr/bin/npm
          test "$(/usr/bin/node --version)" = "$(node --version)"
          test "$(env PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /usr/bin/npm --version)" = "$(npm --version)"
      - run: npm ci --prefix cli
      - run: npm --prefix cli run build
      - run: cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml --bin harness-core --bin nexus-tui
      # Keep the cache-key version list in sync with the pinned tool versions below.
      - name: Restore pinned security and SBOM tools
        id: test-cargo-tools
        uses: actions/cache@caa296126883cff596d87d8935842f9db880ef25 # v5
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/bin
          key: cargo-tools-ci-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('rust-toolchain.toml') }}-audit-0.22.2-deny-0.20.2-cyclonedx-rust-0.5.9-cyclonedx-cli-0.33.1
      - name: Add Cargo tools to PATH
        run: echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Install pinned security and SBOM test tools
        if: steps.test-cargo-tools.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: |
          CARGO_HOME="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}"
          export CARGO_HOME
          mkdir -p "$CARGO_HOME/bin"
          export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
          cargo install cargo-audit --locked --version 0.22.2
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny/releases/download/0.20.2/cargo-deny-0.20.2-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz | tar -xz -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/cargo-deny-0.20.2-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/cargo-deny" "$CARGO_HOME/bin/"
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-rust-cargo/releases/download/cargo-cyclonedx-0.5.9/cargo-cyclonedx-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/cargo-cyclonedx-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/cargo-cyclonedx" "$CARGO_HOME/bin/"
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-cli/releases/download/v0.33.1/cyclonedx-linux-x64 -o "$CARGO_HOME/bin/cyclonedx"
          chmod +x "$CARGO_HOME/bin/cyclonedx"
      - name: Run one shard of the CLI suite with a hang bound
        # The whole suite took 32-34 minutes in one job, so a quarter of it must not need 30; a hung test process
        # must fail the leg, not hold it until the job timeout. The four shards are disjoint and together are every
        # test file (cli/scripts/test_shards.mjs); inside the leg the files run in two processes, as they always did.
        timeout-minutes: 30
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/test-shard"
          export NEXUS_TEST_DURATIONS_OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/test-shard/test-durations.json"
          npm --prefix cli run test:cli -- --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/4 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/test-shard/suite.log"
      # Measured seconds per test file (input of `make test-durations-merge`) and the full suite output of this leg.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          name: test-shard-node${{ matrix.node }}-${{ matrix.shard }}of4
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/test-shard/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14
          overwrite: true

  # The required checks. `always()` makes this job run, and fail, even when a leg failed, was skipped or was cancelled:
  # a skipped required check would count as passing. The result of a matrix job is `success` only when every one of its
  # legs succeeded, so each of the two checks also fails when a leg of the other Node version fails.
  test-matrix:

content.text:
The fan-out is built and uncommitted in `/home/mike/nexus-wt/ci1`. Local checks pass; nothing has run in CI, so the job graph, check names and timings are unconfirmed.

## How the suite runs
- **Before:** `ci.yml:105` ran `npm --prefix cli test` (`test:cli && test:scope`) inside each `test-matrix` job. `test_shards.mjs:110-131` split the files into two shards and ran them concurrently (`Promise.all`), each a `run_tests.mjs` process running files one at a time (`run_tests_driver.mjs:15`, `concurrency: 1`) under the 300 s per-file watchdog.
- **After:** each `test-shard` leg runs `npm --prefix cli run test:cli -- --shard=K/4`. The leg selects its quarter of the files, then runs it in the same two concurrent processes with the same watchdog. With no arguments, `npm test` and `make test` behave as before.
- **Fixtures:** the three shared-fixture evaluator files stay pinned to shard 1.

## Job graph

| Job | needs / if | Timeout | Runs |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test-gates` (node 22, 24) | none | 40 min | full evaluator setup, version/doc/requirements/invariants/deprecated-lock gates, `npm ci`, build, `make lint`, `cargo test`, `test:scope` |
| `test-shard` (node 22, 24 × shard 1–4, `fail-fast: false`) | none | job 50, suite step 30 | full evaluator setup, `npm ci`, build, release core build, cargo tools, one shard; uploads artifact `test-shard-node<N>-<K>of4` (durations + `suite.log`) with `if: always()` |
| `test-matrix` (node 22, 24) | `needs: [test-gates, test-shard]`, `if: always()` | 5 min | fails unless both results are `success` |
| `linux-x86_64` | none | 120 min | as before |
| `diff-coverage` | none | 30 min | as before |

- **Non-suite gates:** they run once per Node version in `test-gates`, because I could not show that lint, `cargo test` or `test:scope` are independent of the Node version.
- **Release build:** `test-gates` does not build the release core; every leg does.
- **`linux-x86_64` and `release.yml`:** `release.yml` is untouched. `linux-x86_64` got only the hygiene items; the base step adds one new env var, `NEXUS_CHANGED_BASE`, which its suite step now sees.

## Decisions for you
- **`always()` instead of `!cancelled()` on the aggregator.** A job skipped by a false `if` reports as passing, so a manual cancel at the PR head could satisfy the required check. With `always()` it runs and fails. Say if you want `!cancelled()`; the parity test pins the current choice.
- **Each `test-matrix` check also fails when a leg of the other Node version fails.** `needs.<matrix job>.result` is one aggregate across all legs. This is stricter, never weaker, and both checks are required anyway. Per-node precision would need the API or marker artifacts.

## Expected wall time
- **Per required check:** leg setup plus about 8–9 minutes of suite, instead of setup plus gates plus 32–34 minutes.
- **Basis:** the 32–34 minute comment in `ci.yml`, divided by four at unchanged in-runner concurrency, with equal size-weighted shards.
- **Not measured:** leg setup time (apt, toolchains, `npm ci`, cold release build) and current job durations. All job timeouts are therefore guesses with headroom.
- **Why four shards:** it puts 12 jobs in flight per run; eight shards would put 20.
- **Balance:** the durations manifest is unchanged (11 measured files of 427), so the first CI runs are balanced by file size.

## Aggregator cases (walked by hand)
1. **All legs pass:** both results `success`, check passes.
2. **One leg fails:** `test-shard` result is `failure`; both `test-matrix` checks fail.
3. **Leg hits a timeout:** the 30-minute step timeout fails the leg; the 50-minute job timeout also yields a non-success result. Check fails.
4. **Leg skipped:** result `skipped`, check fails. Legs and gates have no `if`, and the parity test enforces that.
5. **Run cancelled by the concurrency group:** results are `cancelled`; the aggregator still runs and fails, on the superseded SHA only.
6. **Leg setup fails before tests:** same as case 2; the artifact upload finds nothing and is ignored.

## Workflow-text tests changed
- **`release_workflow_parity.test.ts`:**
  - The evaluator-setup-in-order-before-the-suite assertion now targets `test-shard` instead of `test-matrix`; `linux-x86_64` and release `package` are unchanged at exactly 45 minutes.
  - The shard step must have a step timeout of at most 45.
  - New: `npm test` is exactly `test:cli && test:scope`; the shard matrix is exactly 1..N of `--shard=K/N`; both jobs cover Node 22 and 24; `pipefail` guards the `tee`; `test-gates` carries every former gate plus `test:scope`.
  - New: the aggregator's `needs`, `always()` and result checks, and the absence of a `name:`.
  - New: the concurrency block, a timeout on every job, and `persist-credentials: false` on every checkout.
  - Seven deliberate breakages of `ci.yml` each failed a test.
- **`check_requirements.test.ts`:** the `--enforce` gate is now looked up in `test-gates`. The test additionally requires it to precede `npm ci`, the build and cargo, and requires `test-matrix` to need `test-gates`.
- **`eval_integrity.test.ts`:** the Go pin and toolchain installer counts go from 2 to 3, because three jobs now set up the evaluator environment; all must still be the exact version.

## Shard scripts
- **Selection:** `--shard=K/N` supports N up to 16. A malformed spec, an out-of-range index, an unknown flag or an empty selection fails with exit 2 or 1.
- **Durations bug fixed:** the two concurrent processes used to overwrite the same `NEXUS_TEST_DURATIONS_OUT` file. Each now writes a part and the parent merges them; tests no longer inherit the variable.
- **Merge script:** `cli/scripts/merge_test_durations.mjs` and `make test-durations-merge DIR=<downloaded artifacts>` rebuild `test_durations.json`. It takes the largest measurement per file, drops entries for files that no longer exist, and fails on malformed input.

## Hygiene
All four items are done; none left out.
- **Concurrency:** pull-request runs share a group per PR number and cancel in progress; every other run is alone in a group named after its run id.
- **Timeouts:** on every job, as in the table.
- **`persist-credentials: false`:** on all five checkouts; I found no later step that needs the token.
- **Changed-file base:** on pull requests it is now `HEAD^1` when the checkout is a merge commit, in `test-gates`, `linux-x86_64` and `diff-coverage`. Both `check_fmt.sh` and `diff_coverage.mjs` use `base...HEAD` with full history, so the first parent gives exactly the PR's changes.

## Local verification
- **Type check and lint:** `tsc --noEmit` exit 0; `actionlint` exit 0; YAML parses.
- **Three runs each on Node 24, all passing:** `test_shards` 9/9, `merge_test_durations` 2/2, `release_workflow_parity` 4/4, `check_requirements` 28/28, `verify_action` 9/9, `node_floor` 6/6, `flake_report` 8/8.
- **`eval_integrity`:** 26 pass, 7 fail both before and after, with identical failing sets (host fixtures). The changed assertions sit before the failure point in their test.
- **Partition on the real list (427 files):** N=4 gives 108/105/107/107 files at 25.0% weight each; N=8 gives 52–55 files at 12.5% each. Union is complete and shards are disjoint for both.
- **Dry run of shard 8/8:** 53 files in 463 s, merged durations written. It exited 1 with 16 failures, all from the unbuilt `cli/dist`; after `npm run build` the three affected files passed through the same runner.
- **Gates:** `check_test_leaks` exit 0; `check_invariants` exit 0; `check_requirements --enforce` exit 1 with only the expected clean-worktree complaint.
- **Not done:** no Node 22 run (host has only 24 and 20), which AGENTS.md asks for on test-runner changes.

## Watch in the first CI run
- Check names are exactly `test-matrix (22)` and `test-matrix (24)`, and they go red when a leg fails.
- The aggregated matrix `needs` result and the `always()` behaviour on cancel.
- Eight legs racing to save the same `cargo-tools-ci-…` cache key on a miss (should be harmless).
- `overwrite: true` on artifact names when a run is re-attempted.
- Whether any leg comes close to the 30-minute step bound under size balancing.
- Leg setup time and the 40/50/120/30-minute job timeouts.
- `flake_report` will now see `test-shard (N, K)` jobs plus aggregator failures with no test named.

## Follow-ups not done
- Merge durations from the first green run with `make test-durations-merge`.
- Build the release core once and share it, or cache cargo, to cut per-leg setup.
- Decide whether `linux-x86_64` keeps its own full suite run.
- Teach `flake_report` to ignore the aggregator.

## Housekeeping
- An ignored `cli/dist` build is left in the worktree.
- `git stash` was used once and restored.
- XERJ was not queried because of the no-network rule; the technique came from the supplied `check-test.yml`, ideas only.
- No foreign commits or changes were seen.

- `cli/scripts/merge_test_durations.mjs` (new)
- `cli/test/merge_test_durations.test.ts` (new)
